accepted_findings: Default-off observability and reporting infrastructure is useful and safe.
Broad additive support is not a viable scaling mechanism.
Normalized/provenance selector objectives are not runtime-ready.
Diverse contrast labels confirm Stage7 residual providers remain max_plies under forced ownership.
Protected non-Stage7 training evidence is still too sparse and positive-heavy.
The best current contrast selector has negative_suppression=0.0.

cons: May require slow h40 traces unless a cheaper targeted runner is designed
next_options.description: Collect or reconstruct protected Stage4/5/6 negative ownership labels with the same semantics as positives.
next_options.name: targeted_negative_control_evidence

cons: Still needs validation before runtime use

next_options.name: selector_objective_redesign
pros: Matches observed failure mode: inability to reject bad owners

cons: Does not move causal runtime behavior forward immediately

pros: Avoids overfitting a small lab dataset

recommended_next_class.rationale: The blocker is not selecting positives; it is failing to suppress negatives. Before collecting more expensive labels or implementing runtime behavior, define a selector objective that can abstain/reject unsafe ownership using non-causal protected controls.

runtime_readiness.reason: No candidate can suppress known negative ownership examples in leave-state-out evaluation.
